source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 1-21), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Periodic Table and Periodic Properties) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are Döbereiner's triads? Give one example.
(Döbereiner ke triads kya hain? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: 1829 mein Döbereiner ne milti julti properties wale elements ko triads (teen ke group) mein rakha; darmiyani element ka atomic weight baqi do ki average ke qareeb tha. Misaal: Li (7), Na (23), K (39): (7 + 39) ÷ 2 = 23.

book_ref.quote: In 1829, Döbereiner grouped the elements into triads

blocks.prompt:
2 Three similar elements have atomic masses 32, x and 128. If they form a Döbereiner triad, find x.
(Teen milte julte elements ke atomic masses 32, x aur 128 hain. Agar yeh Döbereiner triad hon to x maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Triad rule se darmiyani mass baqi do ki average hai: x = (32 + 128) ÷ 2 = 160 ÷ 2 = 80.

book_ref.quote: the middle one is the average of the other two, (7 + 39) ÷ 2 = 23

blocks.prompt:
3 What was the contribution of John Newlands to the classification of elements?
(Elements ki taqseem mein John Newlands ka kya hissa tha?)
blocks.explanation: 1864 mein Newlands ne pehli dafa 62 maloom elements mein periodicity (dohraao) dekhi. Barhte atomic masses ki tarteeb mein us ne dekha ke har aathwan element pehle se properties mein milta hai, aur isi tarah group banaye.

book_ref.quote: noticing that the properties of every eighth element were similar

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is Mendeleev called the father of the periodic table? What was the secret of the success of his table?
(Mendeleev ko periodic table ka baap kyun kehte hain? Us ke table ki kamyabi ka raaz kya tha?)
blocks.explanation: 1869 mein Mendeleev ne 63 elements ko barhte atomic mass se aath vertical columns mein rakha. Kamyabi ka raaz: na-daryaft elements ke liye khaali jagah chhorna aur un ke atomic mass aur properties ki pesh-goi karna, jo baad mein sahi sabit hui.

book_ref.quote: The success of his table was hidden in leaving gaps for undiscovered elements

blocks.prompt:
5 What are Lothar Meyer's curves?
(Lothar Meyer ke curves kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1869 mein Lothar Meyer ne elements ke atomic weights aur atomic volumes ka graph banaya. In curves mein bhi properties ki periodicity nazar aayi.

book_ref.quote: Lother Meyer developed his famous curves

blocks.prompt:
6 How did Moseley improve Mendeleev's periodic table?
(Moseley ne Mendeleev ke periodic table ko kaise behtar kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1913 mein Moseley ne X-ray emission se elements ke durust atomic numbers maloom kiye. Us ne atomic masses ki bajaye atomic numbers se tarteeb di, Mendeleev ke table ki khamiyan door keen, aur periodic law badla: properties atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain.

book_ref.quote: This significant breakthrough led Moseley to modify the Periodic Law

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between Mendeleev's and Moseley's arrangement of elements.
(Mendeleev aur Moseley ki elements ki tarteeb mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Mendeleev ne atomic masses aur Moseley ne atomic numbers istemal kiye.

book_ref.quote: arranging the elements by atomic numbers instead of atomic masses

rows: X-ray emission se durust atomic numbers maloom kiye.
Na-daryaft elements ke liye khaali jagah aur properties ki pesh-goi.
Mendeleev ke table ki khamiyan door keen.
Properties ko atomic mass se joda.
Periodic law: properties atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain.

blocks.text: 1.2 Modern periodic table: features and significance

blocks.prompt:
8 Give the main features of the modern periodic table regarding periods and groups.
(Modern periodic table ki periods aur groups ke lihaaz se ahem khasoosiyaat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 118 elements barhte atomic numbers ki tarteeb mein saat horizontal rows (periods) aur atharah vertical columns (groups) mein hain. Purane tables mein 8 groups thay jo aath A-groups aur das B-groups mein taqseem thay.

book_ref.quote: There are seven horizontal rows called periods and eighteen vertical columns called groups

blocks.prompt:
9 Why do elements of the same group show similar chemical properties?
(Aik group ke elements ki chemical properties kyun milti julti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke un mein valence electrons ki tadaad aik jaisi hai. Albatta physical properties oopar se neeche ahista ahista badalti hain.

book_ref.quote: because they have the same number of valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between a period and a group of the periodic table.
(Periodic table ke period aur group mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Period horizontal row hai; group vertical column.

book_ref.quote: Elements in a period show a gradual change in properties moving from left to right in periods

rows: Baayen se daayen properties ahista badalti hain.
Chemical properties milti hain; physical properties oopar se neeche badalti hain.
Period number shells ki tadaad batata hai.
Members ke valence electrons barabar hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between metals and non-metals.
(Metals aur non-metals mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Metals electrons khote hain; non-metals electrons lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Metals are elements which tend to lose electrons to form positive ions

blocks.prompt:
12 What are metalloids? Name four of them.
(Metalloids kya hain? Chaar ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Metalloids (semimetals) mein kuch properties metals ki aur kuch non-metals ki hoti hain; yeh stair-step line ke saath metals ko non-metals se alag karte hain. Misalein: Si, Ge, As, Sb (aur B, Te).

book_ref.quote: The metalloids exhibit some properties of metals and some of non-metals

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the stair-step line of the periodic table?
(Periodic table ki stair-step line kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh lakeer boron (B) se shuru ho kar Si, Ge, As, Sb aur Te se guzarti hui polonium (Po) tak jaati hai. Is ke baayen metals, bilkul daayen metalloids, aur door daayen non-metals hain (hydrogen istisna hai).

book_ref.quote: Mostly periodic tables have a “stair-step line” on the table identifying the element groups

blocks.prompt:
14 On what basis are elements divided into blocks? Name the four blocks with their elements.
(Elements ko blocks mein kis buniyaad par taqseem kiya jata hai? Chaar blocks aur un ke elements batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Valence electrons wale subshell ki buniyaad par. s-block: group 1 aur 2; p-block: group 13 se 18; d-block: transition elements; f-block: lanthanides aur actinides.

book_ref.quote: Elements in the periodic table can be classified based on the subshells containing their valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
15 What is the usefulness of knowing the block of an element?
(Kisi element ka block jaanne ka kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Block jaanne se element ki khasoosiyaat, chemical reactivity, oxidation states, electron bharne ki tarteeb aur electronegativity aur ionization energy jaisi properties ka pata chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Knowing the block to which an element belongs provides valuable information

blocks.prompt:
16 What is an element family? Name the families of the periodic table described in the chapter.
(Element family kya hai? Chapter mein bayan ki gayi families ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Element family aise elements ka majmooa hai jin ki properties mushtarak hon. Chapter chhe families batata hai: alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, transition metals, chalcogens, halogens aur noble gases.

book_ref.quote: An element family is a set of elements sharing common properties

blocks.prompt:
17 Why are group 1 elements called alkali metals? Give their two characteristics.
(Group 1 ke elements ko alkali metals kyun kehte hain? Un ki do khasoosiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh paani se react kar ke alkalis banate hain (maslan sodium, potassium). Un ka aik valence electron hai aur ionization energy kam hai (density aur melting point bhi kam); yeh sab se reactive metals hain.

book_ref.quote: Elements in the group 1 of the periodic table are known as alkali metals

blocks.prompt:
18 Why are group 2 elements called alkaline earth metals? Why are they divalent?
(Group 2 ke elements ko alkaline earth metals kyun kehte hain? Yeh divalent kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh zyada tar zameen mein milte hain aur alkalis banate hain, is liye alkaline earth metals (maslan calcium, magnesium). Un ke valence shell mein do electrons hain, is liye divalent hain.

book_ref.quote: Group 2 elements are metals primarily found in the earth and form alkalis

blocks.prompt:
19 Compare alkali metals with alkaline earth metals.
(Alkali metals aur alkaline earth metals ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Alkali metals group 1 (aik valence electron); alkaline earth metals group 2 (do valence electrons).

book_ref.quote: They are metallic solids that are harder and denser than alkali metals

rows: Kam density; nisbatan kam melting point.
Alkali metals se zyada sakht aur dense.
Zyada tar zameen mein; alkalis banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
20 Give four properties of transition elements.
(Transition elements ki chaar properties likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Transition elements (sab se badi family, d- aur f-block) ki thermal aur electrical conductivity zyada, melting point zyada, density zyada aur oxidation states badalti hain; aksar rangeen compounds banate hain.

book_ref.quote: They exhibit high thermal and electrical conductivities, high melting points

blocks.prompt:
21 Why are group 16 elements called chalcogens?
(Group 16 ke elements ko chalcogens kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke copper (Greek chalkos) ki zyada tar ores oxides ya sulfides hain. Is group mein O, S aur Se non-metals, Te metalloid, aur Po aur livermorium metals hain.

book_ref.quote: The group 16 elements are called Chalcogens

blocks.prompt:
22 Why are group 17 elements called halogens?
(Group 17 ke elements ko halogens kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Halogen ka matlab "salt-former" (namak banane wala) hai: yeh elements (F, Cl, Br) alkali aur alkaline earth metals se aasani se mil kar mustahkam halide salts banate hain. Yeh aik electron le kar bahar wala shell mukammal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Elements in group 17, known as halogens, are nonmetallic

blocks.prompt:
23 Why are noble gases almost unreactive? Why was the name "inert gases" changed?
(Noble gases taqreeban ghair-reactive kyun hain? "Inert gases" ka naam kyun badla gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Un ka bahar wala shell mukammal (stable configuration) hai, is liye shaz-o-naadir compounds banati hain. Kyun ke kuch compounds maloom hain, maslan XePtF₆, is liye inert gases ka naam noble gases kar diya gaya.

book_ref.quote: the word inert gases was changed to noble gases

blocks.prompt:
24 What do the period number and group number of an element tell us?
(Kisi element ka period number aur group number kya batate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Period number principal quantum number n yani shells ki tadaad batata hai; valence electrons nth shell mein hote hain. Group number valence electrons ki tadaad batata hai, aur block subshell (s, p ...) batata hai.

book_ref.quote: The period number indicates the principal quantum number (n), representing the number of electron shells

blocks.prompt:
25 An element lies in period 2 and group 13. Write its electronic configuration and number of valence electrons.
(Aik element period 2 aur group 13 mein hai. Us ki electronic configuration aur valence electrons ki tadaad likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Period 2: do shells, valence electrons doosre shell mein. Group 13: 3 valence electrons (2s² 2p¹). Configuration: 1s² 2s² 2p¹; valence electrons = 3.

book_ref.quote: It means that the 3 valence electron are in the 3rd shell

blocks.prompt:
26 An element has the configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹. Find its period, group and block.
(Aik element ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹ hai. Us ka period, group aur block maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Teen shells, is liye period 3. Aik valence electron, is liye group 1. Valence electron 3s subshell mein, is liye s-block element.

book_ref.quote: an element X in the 3rd period has three electron shells

blocks.prompt:
27 State the Modern Periodic Law. Why is it called the cornerstone of the periodic table?
(Modern Periodic Law bayan karein. Ise periodic table ka "cornerstone" (buniyaadi pathar) kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: "Elements ki physical aur chemical properties un ke atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain." Yeh cornerstone hai kyun ke atomic number ki tarteeb mein milti julti properties wale elements muqarrara faaslon par aate hain.

book_ref.quote: This law is the “cornerstone” of the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
28 Why do properties vary systematically within a group and a period?
(Group aur period mein properties ek nizaam ke saath kyun badalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke atomic number barhne ke saath nucleus mein protons ahista ahista barhte hain aur naye electron shells judte hain.

book_ref.quote: the physical and chemical properties of elements vary systematically within a group and a period

blocks.prompt:
29 Define atomic radius. In which units is it measured?
(Atomic radius ki definition likhein. Yeh kin units mein naapa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic radius atom ke size ka paimana hai: aapas mein bonded do aik jaise atoms ke darmiyan faasle ka aadha. Yeh picometres (pm) ya angstroms (Å) mein naapa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is half of the distance between two identical atoms bonded together

blocks.prompt:
30 The distance between the nuclei of two identical bonded atoms is 154 pm. Find the atomic radius.
(Do aik jaise bonded atoms ke nuclei ka faasla 154 pm hai. Atomic radius maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Atomic radius = faasle ka aadha = 154 ÷ 2 = 77 pm.

book_ref.quote: The atomic radius can vary depending on the type of bond

blocks.prompt:
31 Why does atomic radius decrease across a period?
(Period mein atomic radius kyun kam hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period mein baayen se daayen nuclear charge barhta hai aur naya shell nahi judta; zyada nuclear charge electron cloud ko qareeb kheench leta hai, is liye atom chhota ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Generally, atomic radius decreases across a period

blocks.prompt:
32 Atomic radius increases down a group although nuclear charge also increases. Explain.
(Group mein neeche nuclear charge barhne ke bawajood atomic radius kyun barhta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche naye shells judte hain. Naye shells aur andar ke electrons ki zyada shielding nuclear charge ke izafe par haavi ho jaati hai, is liye atom bada ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: so more shielding makes the atom larger despite the increase in nuclear charge

blocks.prompt:
33 Define ionic radius.
(Ionic radius ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ionic radius crystal lattice mein ion ke size ka paimana hai: ion ke nucleus se us ke bahar wale shell tak ka faasla, pm ya Å mein.

book_ref.quote: It’s typically defined as the distance from the nucleus of an ion to the outermost electron shell

blocks.prompt:
34 Compare the size of a cation and an anion with their parent atoms.
(Cation aur anion ke size ka un ke parent atoms se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Cation apne atom se chhota aur anion apne atom se bada hota hai.

book_ref.quote: When an atom loses one or more electrons to become a positive ion

rows: Baqi electrons nucleus ke qareeb kheenche jaate hain.
Nucleus ki kashish kam aur electron cloud phail jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why do ionic radii increase down a group?
(Group mein neeche ionic radii kyun barhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche principal quantum number n barhta hai aur shells judte hain. Bahar ke electrons nucleus se door ho jaate hain jo nuclear charge ke izafe par haavi hai, is liye cations aur anions dono bade hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The additional electron shells make the ions larger

blocks.prompt:
36 How does the ionic radius of cations change across a period? Why?
(Period mein cations ka ionic radius kaise badalta hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Baayen se daayen kam hota hai, kyun ke barhta nuclear charge electrons ko nucleus ke qareeb kheenchta hai. Isi wajah se anions ka size bhi period mein kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: the ionic radius of cations decreases due to the increasing nuclear charge

blocks.prompt:
37 Define second ionization energy. Write the equation for calcium.
(Second ionization energy ki definition likhein. Calcium ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Second ionization energy (ΔHᵢ₂) gaseous 1+ ions ke aik mole ke har ion se doosra electron nikalne ki energy hai. Ca⁺(g) → Ca²⁺(g) + e⁻, ΔHᵢ₂ = 1150 kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: If a second electron is removed from each ion in a mole of gaseous 1+ ions

blocks.prompt:
38 Using ΔHᵢ₁ = 590 and ΔHᵢ₂ = 1150 kJ mol⁻¹ for calcium, find the energy needed to change 0.2 mol of Ca(g) into Ca²⁺(g).
(Calcium ke ΔHᵢ₁ = 590 aur ΔHᵢ₂ = 1150 kJ mol⁻¹ le kar 0.2 mol Ca(g) ko Ca²⁺(g) banane ki energy maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik mole ke liye: 590 + 1150 = 1740 kJ. 0.2 mol ke liye: 0.2 × 1740 = 348 kJ.

book_ref.quote: An element can have several ionization energies

blocks.prompt:
39 How does nuclear charge affect ionization energy?
(Nuclear charge ionization energy par kaise asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Effective nuclear charge jitna zyada, electron par electrostatic kashish utni zyada aur use nikalna utna mushkil. Is liye effective nuclear charge barhne se ionization energy barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Greater the effective nuclear charge, greater is the electrostatic force of attraction

blocks.prompt:
40 How does the size of an atom affect its ionization energy?
(Atom ka size us ki ionization energy par kaise asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bade atoms mein nucleus aur bahar ke electrons ki kashish kamzor hoti hai, is liye size barhne se ionization energy kam hoti hai, aur ulta bhi.

book_ref.quote: In bigger atoms force of attraction between the nucleus and the outermost electrons is weaker

blocks.prompt:
41 Why do noble gases have the highest ionization energies in their periods?
(Noble gases ki ionization energy apne period mein sab se zyada kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aadhe bhare aur poore bhare orbitals zyada stable hote hain. Noble gases ke shells poore bhare (ns² np⁶) aur bohat stable hain, is liye un se electron nikalna intehai mushkil hai.

book_ref.quote: It is due to highly stable fully-filled shells (ns² np⁶)

blocks.prompt:
42 What is spin-pair repulsion? How does it affect ionization energy?
(Spin-pair repulsion kya hai? Yeh ionization energy par kaise asar karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab aik orbital mein do electrons spin-paired hon to woh aik doosre ko dhakelte hain. Is repulsion se aik paired electron ko nikalna thoda aasaan hota hai, is liye ionization energy unpaired electron ke muqable mein thodi kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: When electrons are spin-paired in the same orbital

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misaal: oxygen ke 2p mein aik orbital mein do paired electrons hain, jab ke nitrogen ke teeno 2p electrons unpaired hain. Is liye oxygen se electron nikalna nitrogen ke muqable mein aasaan hai.

blocks.prompt:
43 How does the shielding effect influence ionization energy?
(Shielding effect ionization energy par kaise asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shielding jitni zyada, valence electrons nikalna utna aasaan. Andar ke electrons zyada hon to screening zyada aur ionization energy kam.

book_ref.quote: Greater the shielding, easier it is to remove the valence electrons from an atom

blocks.prompt:
44 Why does ionization energy decrease from top to bottom in a group?
(Group mein oopar se neeche ionization energy kyun kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche nuclear charge barhta hai magar atomic size aur shielding electrons bhi barhte hain. Valence electron door hota hai (maslan Cs ka 6s, Rb ke 5s ke muqable mein), is liye IE kam: Li > Na > K > Rb > Cs.

book_ref.quote: Going down in a group, the nuclear charge increases but as the size of the atom

blocks.prompt:
45 Why does ionization energy increase across a period?
(Period mein ionization energy kyun barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period mein shells wahi rehte hain aur effective nuclear charge barhta hai. Usi shell mein judne wale electrons shielding nahi badalte, is liye electron nikalna mushkil aur IE zyada hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the shielding effect within the same shell is same so not considered

blocks.prompt:
46 The first ionization energy of sodium is 494 kJ mol⁻¹. How much energy is needed to ionize 0.05 mol of gaseous sodium atoms?
(Sodium ki first ionization energy 494 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. 0.05 mol gaseous sodium atoms ko ionize karne ke liye kitni energy chahiye?)

book_ref.quote: The energy needed to remove one electron from each atom in one mole of atoms

blocks.prompt:
47 Define first electron affinity. Why is the first electron affinity of chlorine negative?
(First electron affinity ki definition likhein. Chlorine ki first electron affinity manfi kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: First electron affinity woh enthalpy change hai jab standard haalat mein 1 mole gaseous atoms mein 1 mole electrons daal kar 1 mole gaseous uni-negative ions bante hain. Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻(g), ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹; manfi kyun ke energy kharij hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The first electron affinity, (ΔH°ₑₐ₁), is the enthalpy change involved

blocks.prompt:
48 Define second electron affinity. Why is it positive for oxygen?
(Second electron affinity ki definition likhein. Oxygen ke liye yeh positive kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Second electron affinity woh energy hai jo 1 mole uni-negative gaseous ions mein electrons daal kar 1 mole gaseous 2− ions banane ke liye chahiye. O⁻(g) + e⁻ → O²⁻(g) mein 798 kJ mol⁻¹ jazb hoti hai, is liye ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = +798 kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: is the amount of energy required to add electrons to 1 mole of uni-negative gaseous ions

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: O⁻ pehle se manfi hai, is liye naya electron us ki taraf dhakela jata hai; usay zabardasti daalne ke liye energy deni padti hai.

blocks.prompt:
49 Using ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −141 and ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = +798 kJ mol⁻¹, find the enthalpy change for converting 0.25 mol of O(g) into O²⁻(g).
(ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −141 aur ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = +798 kJ mol⁻¹ le kar 0.25 mol O(g) ko O²⁻(g) banane ki enthalpy change maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik mole ke liye: (−141) + (+798) = +657 kJ. 0.25 mol ke liye: 0.25 × 657 = +164.25 kJ ≈ +164 kJ (energy jazb).

book_ref.quote: can be calculated by adding the first and second electron affinities

blocks.prompt:
50 How does atomic size affect electron affinity?
(Atomic size electron affinity par kaise asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhote atoms mein nucleus aane wale electron ko zyada zor se kheenchta hai. Is liye atom jitna chhota, electron affinity utni zyada.

book_ref.quote: For small sized atoms the attraction of the nucleus for the incoming electron is stronger

blocks.prompt:
51 Why are the electron affinities of nitrogen and phosphorus very low?
(Nitrogen aur phosphorus ki electron affinities bohat kam kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: N (2s² 2p³) aur P (3s² 3p³) ke valence shell mein aadhe bhare np orbitals hain. Yeh aadhe bhare p-subshells bohat stable hain aur extra electron lene ka rujhan bohat kam hai.

book_ref.quote: These half-filled p-subshells, being very stable

blocks.prompt:
52 Why do noble gases have positive first electron affinities?
(Noble gases ki first electron affinity positive kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Noble gases ki ns² np⁶ configuration stable hai, is liye un ke atoms extra electron qubool nahi karte; energy deni padti, jo positive first electron affinity se zahir hai.

book_ref.quote: Noble gases group-18 (VIII-A) have stable ns² np⁶ configuration

blocks.prompt:
53 Why does electron affinity generally decrease down a group?
(Group mein neeche electron affinity aam taur par kyun kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche atomic size barhta hai; bada electron cloud aane wale electron par nucleus ki kashish kam kar deta hai, is liye electron affinity kam hoti hai (halogens: At < I < Br < F < Cl).

book_ref.quote: Consequently, electron affinity generally decreases down the group

blocks.prompt:
54 Why do electron affinities become more negative across a period?
(Period mein electron affinities zyada manfi kyun hoti jaati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle, nuclear charge barhta hai jo extra electron ko zyada kheenchta hai; doosre, atomic radius kam hota hai. Is liye baayen se daayen zyada energy kharij hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This is firstly due to increase in the nuclear charge

blocks.prompt:
55 Using Table 1.1, arrange Li, Na, K, Rb and Cs by their electron affinities and state the trend.
(Table 1.1 ki madad se Li, Na, K, Rb aur Cs ko electron affinity ke hisaab se tarteeb dein aur trend batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kharij energy ke lihaaz se Li (−60.0) > Na (−53.0) > K (−48.0) > Rb (−47.0) > Cs (−46.0) kJ/mol. Group 1 mein neeche size barhne se electron affinity kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 1.1: Electron Affinities (kJ/Mol) for Group 1 and Group 17

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between ionization energy and electron affinity.
(Ionization energy aur electron affinity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ionization energy mein electron nikalta hai; electron affinity mein electron judta hai.

book_ref.quote: As the atomic size increases down the group

rows: Gaseous atoms se electron nikalne ki energy.
Gaseous atoms mein electron daalne par enthalpy change.
Energy jazb hoti hai, maslan Na: 494 kJ mol⁻¹.
First EA mein aam taur par energy kharij, maslan Cl: −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹.
Group mein neeche kam; period mein zyada.
Group mein neeche aam taur par kam; period mein zyada manfi.

blocks.prompt:
57 Define electronegativity. What is the range of the Pauling scale?
(Electronegativity ki definition likhein. Pauling scale ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electronegativity molecule mein atom ki shared electron pair ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat hai. Pauling ki be-unit qeematein alkali metals ke liye aik se thodi kam se fluorine ke liye zyada se zyada chaar tak hain.

book_ref.quote: which range from just below one for alkali metals to a maximum of four for fluorine

blocks.prompt:
58 Differentiate between electronegativity and electron affinity.
(Electronegativity aur electron affinity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electronegativity molecule mein shared pair se mutaliq hai; electron affinity gaseous atom mein electron daalne se.

book_ref.quote: Electronegativity is the power of an atom to attract shared pair of electrons

rows: Molecule mein shared electron pair kheenchne ki taqat.
1 mole gaseous atoms mein 1 mole electrons daalne par enthalpy change.

blocks.prompt:
59 For what were Linus Pauling's two Nobel Prizes awarded?
(Linus Pauling ko do Nobel Prizes kis kaam par mile?)
blocks.explanation: Chemistry, 1954, chemical bond ki fitrat par kaam ke liye; Peace, 1962, aam tabahi ke hathiyaron ki mukhalfat par. Woh do ghair-mushtarak Nobel Prizes lene wale wahid shakhs hain.

book_ref.quote: Linus Pauling is the only person to have received two unshared Nobel Prizes

blocks.prompt:
60 Why does electronegativity increase across a period and decrease down a group?
(Period mein electronegativity kyun barhti hai aur group mein neeche kyun kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period mein nuclear charge barhta aur size ghatta hai, is liye bonded electrons ki kashish barhti hai (Li 1.0 se F 4.0). Group mein neeche shells aur shielding barhti hai, is liye kam (F 4.0 se I 2.5).

book_ref.quote: This is due to increasing nuclear charge and decreasing size

blocks.prompt:
61 Why are metals called electropositive and non-metals electronegative?
(Metals ko electropositive aur non-metals ko electronegative kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Metals periodic table ke baayen hain aur un ki electronegativity non-metals se kam hai. Is liye nisbatan metals electropositive aur non-metals electronegative hain.

book_ref.quote: Normally, metals being on the left side of the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
62 Define metallic character. Why does it decrease across a period?
(Metallic character ki definition likhein. Period mein yeh kyun kam hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Metallic character element ka electrons khone ka rujhan hai. Period mein nuclear charge barhta aur size ghatta hai, is liye valence electrons mazbooti se jakde jaate hain aur khona mushkil; metallic character kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, metallic character decreases across a period from left to right

blocks.prompt:
63 Why do elements on the left of the periodic table form positive ions while those on the right form negative ions?
(Periodic table ke baayen elements positive ions aur daayen elements negative ions kyun banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Baayen ke elements noble gas configuration paane ke liye bahar ke electrons aasani se kho kar positive ions (metals) banate hain. Daayen ke elements electrons le kar negative ions (non-metals) banate hain.

book_ref.quote: elements on the left side of the periodic table are metals that form positive ions

blocks.prompt:
64 How does magnesium react with cold water and with steam? Write the equations.
(Magnesium thande paani aur steam se kaise react karta hai? Equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Paani se Mg ahista react karta hai: Mg(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Mg(OH)₂ + H₂(g). Steam se zyada zor se: Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g).

book_ref.quote: Mg reacts more slowly in forming magnesium hydroxide and hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
65 Why is sodium kept under kerosene oil?
(Sodium ko kerosene oil mein kyun rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium khuli hawa mein oxygen se zor se react kar ke peroxide banata hai. Kerosene mein rakhne se hawa se reaction ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Sodium is kept under kerosene oil to prevent its reaction with air

blocks.prompt:
66 What products are formed when sodium reacts with oxygen in open air and under limited oxygen? Give equations.
(Sodium khuli hawa mein aur kam oxygen mein oxygen se react kare to kya banta hai? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation: Khuli hawa mein sodium peroxide: 2Na(s) + O₂(g) → Na₂O₂(s). Kam O₂ ya zyada temperature par sodium oxide: 4Na(s) + O₂(g) → 2Na₂O(s).

book_ref.quote: Under special conditions like limited O₂ or high temperature, sodium oxide is formed

blocks.prompt:
67 Why is magnesium powder used in fireworks and S.O.S. flares? Write the equation of its burning.
(Magnesium powder fireworks aur S.O.S. flares mein kyun istemal hota hai? Jalne ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium powder bohat tezi se tez safaid shole se jalta hai aur safaid solid magnesium oxide banta hai: 2Mg(s) + O₂(g) → 2MgO(s).

book_ref.quote: Magnesium powder burns very rapidly with an intense white flame

blocks.prompt:
68 What is observed when sodium and magnesium react with chlorine? Give equations.
(Sodium aur magnesium chlorine se react karein to kya nazar aata hai? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation: Sodium sunehre peele shole ke saath exothermic reaction kar ke safaid solid NaCl banata hai: 2Na(s) + Cl₂(g) → 2NaCl(s). Magnesium safaid solid MgCl₂ deta hai: Mg(s) + Cl₂(g) → MgCl₂(s). Dono salts hal pazeer hain.

book_ref.quote: Chlorine reacts with both metals to give soluble salts

blocks.prompt:
69 What is a basic oxide? Give an example with equation.
(Basic oxide kya hai? Equation ke saath misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Basic oxide paani se mil kar alkali deta hai. Metals (group 1 aur 2) basic oxides banate hain jo aam taur par ionic hain. Misaal: CaO(s) + H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂(aq).

book_ref.quote: A basic oxide is an oxide that when combined with water gives off an alkali

blocks.prompt:
70 Why is aluminium oxide called amphoteric? Give equations.
(Aluminium oxide ko amphoteric kyun kehte hain? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation: Al₂O₃ acids aur bases dono se react karta hai. HCl se: Al₂O₃ + 6HCl → 2AlCl₃ + 3H₂O. NaOH se (sodium aluminate): Al₂O₃ + 2NaOH → Na₂Al₂O₄ + H₂O.

book_ref.quote: Aluminum oxide (Al₂O₃) is insoluble in water but reacts with hydrochloric acid

blocks.prompt:
71 Why is silicon dioxide called an acidic oxide? Give the equation.
(Silicon dioxide ko acidic oxide kyun kehte hain? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh bases se react karta hai: SiO₂(s) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SiO₃(aq) + H₂O(l).

book_ref.quote: Silicon dioxide is acidic oxide as it can react with bases

blocks.prompt:
72 Differentiate between basic oxides and acidic oxides.
(Basic oxides aur acidic oxides mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Basic oxides paani se alkali dete hain; acidic oxides acid.

book_ref.quote: Non-metals react with oxygen to form acidic oxides

blocks.prompt:
73 Why does alkalinity increase down group 2?
(Group 2 mein neeche alkalinity kyun barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 ke hydroxides ki solubility neeche barhti hai, is liye un ke solutions zyada alkaline hote jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: Group 2 hydroxides solubility increases down the group so alkalinity also increases down the group

blocks.prompt:
74 Write the balanced equation for the reaction of P₂O₃ with water and name the acid formed.
(P₂O₃ aur paani ke reaction ki balanced equation likhein aur banne wale acid ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: P₂O₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → 2H₃PO₃(aq). Jaanch: dono taraf 2 P, 6 O aur 6 H. Acid H₃PO₃ (phosphorous acid) hai, is liye P₂O₃ acidic oxide hai.

book_ref.quote: This equation is not balanced: 2 P and 4 O on the left

blocks.prompt:
75 What is hydration? Give an example.
(Hydration kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab NaCl jaisa chloride react kiye baghair ghulta hai to us ke musbat aur manfi ions paani ke molecules se ghir jaate hain (hydrated ions); yeh hydration hai. NaCl(s) → Na⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq), pH = 7.

book_ref.quote: this process is known as hydration

blocks.prompt:
76 What is hydrolysis? Explain with AlCl₃.
(Hydrolysis kya hai? AlCl₃ ke saath wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrolysis chloride ka paani se reaction hai jo solution ko acidic (pH < 7) banata hai. Hydrated Al³⁺ paani ke molecule se H⁺ alag karwata hai: AlCl₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → Al(OH)₃(s) + 3HCl(aq).

book_ref.quote: When AlCl₃ is added to water, aluminium and chloride ions in solution

blocks.prompt:
77 Differentiate between hydration and hydrolysis of chlorides.
(Chlorides ki hydration aur hydrolysis mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydration mein chloride sirf ghulta hai; hydrolysis mein paani se react karta hai.

book_ref.quote: If we move in period 3, from aluminium to sulphur all chlorides react with water

rows: Chloride paani se react nahi karta.
Chloride paani se react karta hai.
Ions paani ke molecules se ghir jaate hain.
Paani ka molecule H⁺ khota hai (HCl banta hai).

blocks.prompt:
78 Write the equations for the reactions of SiCl₄ and PCl₃ with water.
(SiCl₄ aur PCl₃ ke paani se reactions ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: SiCl₄(l) + 2H₂O(l) → SiO₂(s) + 4HCl(aq); PCl₃(l) + 3H₂O(l) → H₃PO₃ + 3HCl(aq). Banne wala HCl dono solutions ko acidic karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Other examples of acidic chlorides are given below.

blocks.text: 1.9 Trends in bonding in the oxides and chlorides of period 3

blocks.prompt:
79 Why does the covalent character of chlorides increase across period 3?
(Period 3 mein chlorides ka covalent character kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period mein chlorine aur doosre atom ki electronegativity ka farq kam hota jata hai. Is liye NaCl (group 1) zyada tar ionic hai, jab ke baad ke groups ke chlorides, maslan PCl₅, covalent hain.

book_ref.quote: The covalent character in chlorides increases due to decrease in difference of electronegativity

blocks.prompt:
80 Differentiate between the structures of Na₂O and SO₂.
(Na₂O aur SO₂ ki banawat mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Na₂O ionic (giant lattice) hai; SO₂ covalent (molecules).

book_ref.quote: These oxides exist as giant ionic lattices with strong electrostatic forces

rows: Baad ke group ka oxide (period 3 ke daayen).
Mukhalif charge wale ions mein mazboot electrostatic forces.

blocks.text: 1.10 Variation in oxidation number in oxides and chlorides

blocks.prompt:
81 Define oxidation number. What is it in an ionic compound?
(Oxidation number ki definition likhein. Ionic compound mein yeh kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number (oxidation state) molecule ya ion mein atom par formal charge hai. Ionic compounds mein yeh ion ka charge hai, maslan MgCl₂ mein Mg ka +2.

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number of an atom is the formal charge on that atom in a molecule or ion

blocks.prompt:
82 Why is the oxidation number of period 3 elements in their oxides and chlorides always positive?
(Period 3 ke elements ka oxidation number un ke oxides aur chlorides mein hamesha positive kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen aur chlorine in tamam elements se zyada electronegative hain, is liye bonding electrons O ya Cl ke shumaar hote hain. Period 3 ke element ka oxidation number bonding mein lage electrons ke barabar aur positive hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number of an element of 3rd Period in its oxide or chloride corresponds to the number of electrons used for bonding

blocks.prompt:
83 Taking O as −2, calculate the oxidation numbers of phosphorus in P₄O₁₀ and P₄O₆.
(O ko −2 le kar P₄O₁₀ aur P₄O₆ mein phosphorus ke oxidation numbers maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Table 1.2: Oxidation Numbers in Oxides and Chlorides of 3rd Period elements

blocks.prompt:
84 Taking Cl as −1, find the oxidation numbers of sulphur in SCl₂ and silicon in SiCl₄.
(Cl ko −1 le kar SCl₂ mein sulphur aur SiCl₄ mein silicon ke oxidation numbers maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: SCl₂: x + 2(−1) = 0, x = +2. SiCl₄: x + 4(−1) = 0, x = +4. Dono positive hain, jaisa period 3 ke elements ke chlorides mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is +2: each Cl is -1 and the molecule is neutral

blocks.prompt:
85 How is the highest oxidation number of a period 3 element in its oxide related to its group?
(Period 3 ke element ka oxide mein sab se zyada oxidation number us ke group se kaise juda hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bonding mein lage kul valence electrons ke barabar hai (purani numbering 1–7 mein group number; groups 13–17 mein group number minus 10): Na +1 (Na₂O), Mg +2, Al +3, Si +4, P +5 (P₄O₁₀), S +6 (SO₃).

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number matches the group number, reflecting the total number of valence electrons
